blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Autoregressive language models are trained by next-token cross-entropy, yet several recent systems also iterate a hidden state without emitting a token: continuous thoughts, pause steps, and recurrent depth. This note separates three risks on one latent process. The token risk $R_{\mathrm{tok}}$ scores a readout. The teacher-forced latent risk $R_1$ scores a one-step map that sees the true hidden state. The open-loop risk $R_H$ scores the same map after it has been iterated on its own outputs. If the Bayes next-token posterior is a function of a $k$-dimensional statistic with full-rank covariance, a width-$k$ latent, a linear least-squares transition, and a refit unembedding match the Bayes token predictor. The statistic is identified only up to an invertible gauge: whitening the residual stream does not change the token law once the unembedding is refit. The matching obstructions are sharp. A constant latent drives $R_1$ to zero while token cross-entropy falls back to the marginal entropy. A perfect token predictor can still hide a null-space walk whose open-loop error grows linearly in the horizon. A small next-latent loss does not certificate next-token prediction, and a small next-token loss does not certificate free latent rollout, unless a rank or injectivity condition is stated with the number.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Next-token prediction is the training loss of modern language models [ Bengio et al., 2003 , Vaswani et al., 2017 , Radford et al., 2019 , Brown et al., 2020 , Hoffmann et al., 2022 , Touvron et al., 2023a , Grattafiori et al., 2024 ] .
Read information-theoretically, that loss is compression of the token process [ Shannon, 1948 , Cover and Thomas, 2006 , Delétang et al., 2024 ] .
The residual stream is where the computation is written [ Elhage et al., 2021 , Geva et al., 2022 , Belrose et al., 2023 ] .
Chain-of-thought spells intermediate steps as tokens [ Wei et al., 2022 , Kojima et al., 2022 ] .
A newer family keeps the step inside the vector: continuous thoughts feed the hidden state back as the next embedding [ Hao et al., 2024 ] , pause tokens and quiet rationales buy extra computation beside the answer [ Goyal et al., 2024 , Zelikman et al., 2024 ] , and recurrent-depth models unroll a latent block at test time [ Geiping et al., 2025 , Dehghani et al., 2019 ] .

(i) Token risk, teacher-forced latent risk, and open-loop latent risk are defined on one process (Section 3 ).
(ii) A finite-dimensional predictive sufficient statistic is enough for Bayes token prediction, and linear least squares identifies it up to an invertible gauge (Section 4 ).

(iv) Two obstructions: latent collapse, and a null-space walk that the unembedding cannot see (Section 6 ).
(v) A Lipschitz bound on free latent rollout, with a matching linear lower bound (Section 7 ).

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Neural language models estimate a conditional distribution over the next token [ Bengio et al., 2003 , Mikolov et al., 2010 ] .
Transformers implement that conditional with self-attention [ Vaswani et al., 2017 , Dai et al., 2019 , Su et al., 2024 , Dao et al., 2022 ] , and scale reliably with data and compute [ Kaplan et al., 2020 , Hoffmann et al., 2022 , Brown et al., 2020 , Touvron et al., 2023a , Touvron et al., 2023b , Grattafiori et al., 2024 , Jiang et al., 2023 , Raffel et al., 2020 ] .
Bidirectional masked models are a different conditional [ Devlin et al., 2019 ] .
Instruction tuning and preference optimization change the target distribution, not the fact that the reported loss is a token loss [ Ouyang et al., 2022 , Rafailov et al., 2023 ] .
Analyses of the residual stream treat the hidden state as the place where the next-token computation is written [ Elhage et al., 2021 , Olsson et al., 2022 , Geva et al., 2021 , Geva et al., 2022 , Belrose et al., 2023 , Meng et al., 2022 , Todd et al., 2024 ] .
In-context learning has been explained as Bayesian inference and as implicit gradient descent on a latent task [ Xie et al., 2022 , Akyürek et al., 2023 , von Oswald et al., 2023 , Saunshi et al., 2021 ] .
Those accounts already assume a latent that is sufficient for the next token.
This paper asks when a predictive loss on that latent recovers the token conditional, and when it does not.

blocks.en:
Next-token language models and next-latent predictors share a prefix and a one-step arrow, and they score different objects.
